methodology.scope: All 27 names in GPU source.rs SOURCES, SF1, all configurations inventoried including no-reduce. Parent priority override authorizes 600-second combined wall budget/config, adaptive three-run timing, and same-family >10x GPU pruning.
methodology.invocations: Fresh release workers include unchanged authored queries and comparison/runtime. First phase used stock worker: one warm execution then five timed runs. After priority override generated harness uses three timed runs when warm query or any first-three timed run exceeds60s, otherwise five. Independent counters warm run and separately instrumented profile worker. Actual run counts recorded per row.
methodology.correctness: DuckDB Python executes identical authored SQL over the same /data/tpch-gpu/sf1/dbgen.duckdb. Compare normalized exact answer sets before measurement and after every timed run. Only DECIMAL columns have trailing zeros normalized; no floating tolerance. Separate counter/profile operator row graphs and primitive insertion totals are also checked.
methodology.plain_boundary: Instant surrounds query::run, including query-local preprocessing, index construction, collection/cloning into native answers. Parquet load, canonicalization, sorting, oracle comparison, serialization and final answer destruction are excluded.
methodology.profile_boundary: Same query::run plus operator timing instrumentation. Report build and residual from the very same execution selected by median profile total; residual = profile total - exclusive build. These are NOT independent medians of phase samples.
methodology.build_definition: Runtime render_operators BUILD_EXCLUSIVE_TOTAL sums elapsed.saturating_sub(source_elapsed) for every operator kind ending _BUILD. Source production is excluded from construction. The emitted tree rounds build total to 0.001ms; residual has corresponding rounding uncertainty. Inclusive stream times must not be summed.
methodology.ranking: Best observed LE minimizes uninstrumented whole-query median among completed cq_planners::order(le) configurations (le and le_runs). Family pruning means it is not necessarily the global best; le_search_complete flags coverage. Default is separate and never substitutes for unavailable LE.
limitations: Profile-only insertion drains each build input into a Vec before construction; its buffering, clock and operator bookkeeping overhead can substantially alter execution. Profile phase numbers are instrumented, not an exact split of the uninstrumented median.
No subtraction combines uninstrumented total and profile build. Both totals and overhead are retained.
Load and any ZoneRows preparation are excluded from query total and separately reported; query-local preprocessing remains in total and residual unless covered by a build operator.
Samples are sorted by the worker; execution order is not retained. First phase completed five-run results are not discarded or retrospectively censored.
Only SF1 is collected here; no CPU SF10 claim.
Timeout is a wall limit across process load, warm verification, measured runs, correctness checks and separate modes; it is NOT a lower bound on one query invocation.
Rows with successful plain timing but missing/timed-out profile retain uninstrumented total and correctness; phase split remains null.

The 12 standalone default-only queries pass exact-answer and operator-graph checks, but their primitive distinct_insertions counters disagree with operator set_insertions. primitive_build_counts_verified=false records this diagnostic separately; no independent set-insertion verification is claimed for these rows.
